scopeRecords.title: A Frequency Adaptive Transformer for Semantic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images
scopeRecords.primaryAbstract: Semantic segmentation of remote sensing images (RSIs) presents significant challenges, particularly in simultaneously capturing localized fine-grained details and global contextual relationships. To overcome these limitations, we propose the frequency adaptive transformer (FAformer), a novel framework that incorporates a frequency-aware approach into transformer architectures. At its core, the frequency adaptive transformer block (FATB) separates token embeddings into high- and lowfrequency components using a low-pass filter. These components are refined through multi-head high-frequency attention (MHA) for localized patterns and multi-head self-attention (MSA) for global dependencies, enabling precise feature modeling across diverse spatial and spectral complexities. Extensive experiments on the ISPRS Potsdam and LoveDA datasets demonstrate that FAformer achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly surpassing existing methods. Ablation studies further highlight the critical role of MHA in enhancing high-frequency feature modeling, particularly for challenging categories such as roads and vegetation. The source codes will be released at Github.

scopeRecords.title: Semantic-Aware Alignment Network for Cross-Resolution Change Detection
scopeRecords.primaryAbstract: Cross-resolution change detection (CRCD) is of significant practical importance in disaster assessment, rapid urban transitions, and various applications. Conventional change detection methods are primarily tailored for bitemporal images with consistent spatial resolution, rendering them unsuitable for direct application to CRCD tasks. This limitation stems from the substantial scale differences and pixel-wise misalignment prevalent in cross-resolution remote sensing images. In response to these challenges, we introduce a semantic-aware alignment network (SA-Net). SA-Net utilizes cross-attention to map bitemporal images into a shared semantic space, effectively alleviating the difficulties of the subsequent alignment arising from semantic mismatches. Furthermore, a joint transformer featuring an encoder-decoder architecture is employed to extract global information and learn the geometric parameters for spatial alignment between bitemporal images. Experimental evaluations on two real-collected datasets, HTCD and MRCDD, showcase the superior performance of our proposed SA-Net in CRCD tasks.

mftnet.method: 编码器1×1/3×3/1×1卷积、BN与LeakyReLU/Sigmoid，通道128/64/N，N=16。MSFDM对潜在特征分别4/5倍平均池化、上采样并作差，1×1后相加及3×3得HF，LF=Xen−HF；这是空间特征高低频，不是波长曲线傅里叶距离。HFEM将通道四分，普通3×3、膨胀率3的3×3、尺度1/2 MaxPool＋1×1，拼接/1×1和残差；LFRB以当前LF为Q、对应编码特征为K/V，经1×1/DWConv与通道间attention、可学习α及编码残差融合。双支路输出合并，经3×3/BN/Sigmoid自重建；训练文字称MSE，原Eq8写L2范数求和。检测R1=Mahalanobis(异常重建)，R2=Mahalanobis(X−背景重建)，λ=.5加权。
mftnet.datasets: VoR表2六主HSI，均100×100。顺序AVIRIS-2/Texas Coast/Los Angeles/Airport-2/Hyperion/Pavia：保留189/207/205/205/145/102带，异常像元134/155/272/87/32/68，分辨率3.5/17.2/7.1/7.1/30/1.3m；传感器前四AVIRIS、Hyperion、ROSIS-03。目标为飞机/建筑/建筑/飞机/未知/车辆。§3.7另用Segundo110×110、72×72、66×66裁区验证padding，未给该补充的完整传感器/波段/划分。
mftnet.experiments: VoR §3.2–3.6：场景内无标签AE重建，其他深度基线除DFAE均对新场景重新训练；主场景没有独立训练/验证/测试场景划分说明。MFTNet用Adam，lr/weight decay均1e−4，N=16、attention head=1、λ=.5；Pavia200 epochs，其余500。Python3.7/PyTorch-cpu1.13.1、Intel i5-12400/16GB RAM；部分基线MATLAB2022a。13个对照，多项基线参数按各场景AUC择优，N/H/λ也依六场景曲线选择，未说明独立验证。评估3D/2D ROC、八AUC指标、10/90百分位箱图；噪声实验Gaussian均值0、variance .01，以及Hyperion不同SNR。
mftnet.results: VoR表4–9，六主场景AUC(D,F)：.9930/.9981/.9968/.9850/.9984/.9944；Texas Coast的RGAE .9994、PDBSNet .9989更好，另外五个所列最好。表10平均AUC(D,F)=.9943、AUC(D,τ)=.4473、AUC(F,τ)=.0156、AUC(TD)=1.4415、AUC(BS)=.9787、AUC(SNPR)=30.1614、AUC(TDBS)=.4316、AUC(ODP)=1.4259，不是八项全胜。表11含训练/检测CPU秒数288.3376/297.3002/299.5554/297.5359/263.6254/66.0651，不可当纯推理延迟。表15/19单尺度或单支路部分更高；Segundo66的MFTNet .9860低于RGAE .9881。Gaussian噪声Airport-2从.9850降至.9677；训练成本、轮廓模糊与指标边界均保留。
mftnet.limitations: 高频异常/低频背景为模型假设，不是所有异常和纹理背景可严格分离；Airport-2下采样导致模糊，正文明确训练耗时、变尺度适配限制。六场景AUC参与参数选择，无独立验证说明；无标签训练不表示模型选择完全未用GT，收敛曲线/支路可视化不足证明普遍无过拟合。Eq8文字MSE但印式仅L2范数求和，分支通道文字[N,64,128]与Table1 decoder[64,128,C]不统一，按原稿不补实现。Table12/13单位写MB/GB，不擅自改成M参数/GFLOPs；Table20部分clean基线与主表不同（FrFe AVIRIS-2 .9607/.9821），不拼接为统一实测。只记录官方代码链接。
